description: Real-world papers selected before any content was seen. For a stratum of quota q, cut [2015-01-01, 2026-11-01) UTC into q equal windows. In window i take category categories[i mod len(categories)] and query cat:C AND submittedDate:[midpoint TO window end] sorted by submittedDate ascending. The pick is the first result whose primary category is exactly C and which is not already picked. If the second half of the window has none, the same is done on the first half, sorted descending, from the midpoint backwards. No filter looks at anything but id, primary category and date. A pick that later proves unusable is recorded and never replaced. The version is the latest at selection time and is pinned. Sources stay in refs/corpus/arxiv/ and are never committed; this file lists arXiv ids only. Rebuild with tests/corpus/arxiv/sample.py fetch, extract. Tiers: standard holds 40 picks chosen after the oracle run, for speed and variety only: normal, no TeX errors, in the fastest half by total oracle CPU time, greedy on new classes, then strata, then packages, at most 5 per stratum. Everything else is full.

exclusions.why: A pick that cannot be used stays in the manifest as excluded or oracle-fails, so the denominator is the sample as drawn. Replacing it would tune the set.

exclusions.what: E-prints over 30 MB compressed and archives over 256 MB unpacked are not used
exclusions.why: Bound on download volume and on decompression bombs. Listed as excluded entries.

exclusions.what: Archive members that are symlinks, hard links, devices or fifos, that have absolute or .. paths, and any .fmt, texmf.cnf or ls-R, are refused at extraction
exclusions.why: Untrusted input. kpathsea searches . for formats, so a planted .fmt would replace the oracle format. Refused members are counted in refs/corpus/arxiv/extract-log.json, and a document that needed one fails visibly.

exclusions.what: Nested archives inside a source are not unpacked
exclusions.why: arXiv itself does not need them for the top-level compile in nearly all cases. Counted in extract-log.json.

exclusions.what: pdflatex is the only route. XeLaTeX, LuaLaTeX and latex+dvips papers are compiled with pdflatex anyway
exclusions.why: rstex ports pdfTeX. Such papers land in oracle-fails with the reason, or in normal with TeX errors, which is error recovery to reproduce. EPS figures are not converted: with -no-shell-escape pdflatex reports them and carries on.

exclusions.what: The main file is found by a fixed rule (00README first, then a scan), not by asking the authors
exclusions.why: A wrong guess on a paper with several documents still gives a real document to compile. How each was found is in extract-log.json.

exclusions.what: Biber is not run, and no paper-specific texinputs are added
exclusions.why: The runner bounds bibliography tools. Papers ship a .bbl when they need one, which arXiv itself requires.

exclusions.what: The latest version at selection time, pinned; only submission dates 2015-01-01 to 2026-10-31
exclusions.why: Reproducibility, and a sample of the modern source format.

exclusions.what: Papers needing a package or class this TeX Live does not have: 131 of 400 entries when last finalized (2026-11-02)
exclusions.why: They stay here as oracle-fails with the file named in their notes. The TeX Live on this machine is a partial Arch install, so most of these are coverage lost to the machine, not to the papers.
